9A.1 Passover is to be observed.
9A.5 The Feast of Unleavened Bread is to be celebrated the day after Passover (to eat unleavened bread seven days)
9A.6 Wave Sheaf offering (2nd day after Passover).
9A.7 In the first and seventh day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread there shall be an holy convocation, you shall do no servile work.
9A.9 The Feast of Ingathering.
9A.10 Feast of Weeks (Pentecost) -Seven weeks to be counted from the time you begin harvest, then on the fiftieth day you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks.
9A.11 Feast of Trumpets -a day for blowing the trumpets (To do no work on that day).
9A.12 Feast of Tabernacles -you shall keep a feast to the LORD for seven days.
9A.14 On the first and eighth day of the Feast of Tabernacles you shall have a sacred assembly, you shall do no customary work.
9A.15 Day of Atonement - You shall humble your souls and do no work on that day.
9C.13 Divine worship to be celebrated on the Sabbath (a time for holy convocation).
14E.5 You shall 'afflict your souls' (fast) on the Day of Atonement.
15E.1 A small portion of crops are to remain unharvested or unpicked so that they may be left for the poor and fatherless to take.
